Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Profile V2 (`SGLANG_PROFILE_V2=1`) is missing the `PREBUILT` case that the V1 by-stage predicate got in #40098. `_get_stage_from_forward_mode` (`python/sglang/srt/utils/profile_utils.py:175`) maps prefill, decode and `IDLE`, and raises for any other mode:

```
RuntimeError: unsupported profile stage: forward_mode=<ForwardMode.PREBUILT: 7>
```

`Scheduler.run_batch` calls `SchedulerProfilerManager._profile_batch_predicate` on every batch, before its `PREBUILT` early return (`_run_batch_prebuilt`). Under V2 the predicate calls `ProfileManager.step`, which maps the mode before it looks at any profiling state. So a `PREBUILT` batch reaching `run_batch` would kill the scheduler, even with no profile requested. `PREBUILT` is the PD-decode placeholder for requests whose KV just arrived; it never enters a model forward. V1 ignores it.

Reachability: I did not find an in-tree event loop on current main that passes a `PREBUILT` batch to `run_batch`. Since #19568, `get_next_disagg_decode_batch_to_run` makes a new `PREBUILT` batch the running batch, or merges it into it, and `update_running_batch` switches it to `DECODE` before `run_batch` (checked on CPU by calling that function). This was already the case when #40098 fixed V1. `run_batch`, the DP-attention sync and FPM still handle `PREBUILT` explicitly, and so does V1. This change makes V2 handle it the same way.

This carries forward #40383 (@bojiang-li), which was closed by the stale bot without a review.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/utils/profile_utils.py`: `_get_stage_from_forward_mode` returns `None` (no stage) for `PREBUILT`, as it does for `IDLE`. The V2 mapping now classifies every forward mode the same way as the V1 by-stage predicate.
- `test/registered/unit/utils/test_profile_utils.py` (new, `base-a-test-cpu`): starts a decode-stage capture on a real `ProfileManager`, steps it with `ForwardMode.PREBUILT`, and checks that the capture was neither ended nor advanced. `activities=[]`, so no profiler backend runs. On main the test fails with the `RuntimeError` above. It also fails if `PREBUILT` is mapped to a profile stage instead of `None` (checked locally by mapping it to `"prefill"`). No existing test covers `ProfileManager`, so the new file mirrors the source path.

Tests, run locally on a CPU-only machine (Python 3.12):

```
$ python3 test/registered/unit/utils/test_profile_utils.py
Ran 1 test in 0.037s

OK

# the same test with main's profile_utils.py
$ SGLANG_TEST_MAX_RETRY=0 python3 test/registered/unit/utils/test_profile_utils.py
  File ".../python/sglang/srt/utils/profile_utils.py", line 86, in step
    stage = _get_stage_from_forward_mode(forward_mode)
  File ".../python/sglang/srt/utils/profile_utils.py", line 183, in _get_stage_from_forward_mode
    raise RuntimeError(f"unsupported profile stage: {forward_mode=}")
RuntimeError: unsupported profile stage: forward_mode=<ForwardMode.PREBUILT: 7>
...
Exception: retry() exceed maximum number of retries.
Ran 1 test in 0.041s

FAILED (errors=1)
```

Related test files, each run with `python3 -m pytest -q <file>` on this branch:

```
test/registered/unit/utils/test_profile_merger.py: 8 passed, 21 warnings in 15.48s
test/registered/unit/managers/test_detailed_annotations.py: 17 passed, 21 warnings in 16.46s
test/registered/unit/managers/test_disagg_idle_step_counters.py: 22 passed, 22 warnings, 54 subtests passed in 17.68s
test/registered/unit/managers/test_auxiliary_output.py: 33 passed, 22 warnings in 17.29s
test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_decode_cuda_graph_runner.py: 24 passed, 21 warnings, 2 subtests passed in 15.97s
```

A local check outside this PR also called the real `Scheduler.run_batch` with a `PREBUILT` batch and a real `SchedulerProfilerManager` under `SGLANG_PROFILE_V2=1`. No profile was requested, and the rest of the scheduler state was stubbed:

```
# main's profile_utils.py
run_batch(PREBUILT) raised RuntimeError: unsupported profile stage: forward_mode=<ForwardMode.PREBUILT: 7>
# this branch
run_batch(PREBUILT) -> GenerationBatchResult True
```

detail.title: [Fix] profiler: Ignore PREBUILT batches in profile V2 stage mapping

files.patch:
@@ -177,7 +177,9 @@ def _get_stage_from_forward_mode(forward_mode: ForwardMode):
         return "prefill"
     elif forward_mode.is_decode():
         return "decode"
-    elif forward_mode.is_idle():
+    elif forward_mode.is_idle() or forward_mode.is_prebuilt():
+        # PREBUILT is the PD-decode placeholder for requests whose KV just arrived;
+        # it never enters a model forward.
         return None
     else:
         raise RuntimeError(f"unsupported profile stage: {forward_mode=}")

@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+"""Unit tests for srt/utils/profile_utils.py"""
+
+import copy
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.utils.profile_utils import ProfileManager
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, published_topology
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestProfileManager(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_prebuilt_batch_leaves_running_capture_untouched(self):
+        """PREBUILT batches (PD decode admission) run no model forward;
+        stepping one must not raise, and must leave a running capture unchanged."""
+        with published_topology():
+            manager = ProfileManager(cpu_group=None)
+            manager.configure(
+                output_dir=None,
+                start_step=None,
+                num_steps=1,
+                # An empty activity list starts no profiler backend.
+                activities=[],
+                with_stack=None,
+                record_shapes=None,
+                profile_by_stage=True,
+                profile_id="test",
+                merge_profiles=False,
+                profile_prefix="",
+                profile_stages=["decode"],
+            )
+            manager.step(forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE)
+            # step() updates the running state in place, so compare against a copy.
+            capture = copy.copy(manager.stage_based_trigger.running_state)
+
+            manager.step(forward_mode=ForwardMode.PREBUILT)
+
+        self.assertIsNotNone(capture)
+        self.assertEqual(manager.stage_based_trigger.running_state, capture)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
